metadata.evidence: Fresh launched managed Maya 2024 PID 17012 exited while running the planner with pure-Python selector/group-builder stubs and an MFnMesh captured before skinCluster history insertion. This excluded cmds.polySelect and made stale function-set lifetime across history mutation the primary hypothesis.

Fresh launched managed Maya 2024 PID 16220 completed run_skirt_parent_postskin_meshfn_stub_selector_source_query_smoke with AIBRIDGE_UI_SMOKE_OK:SKINNING_SKIRT_PARENT_POSTSKIN_MESHFN_STUB_SELECTOR_SOURCE_QUERY_SMOKE_OK. The only material A/B change from the crashing 036n path was resolving a new MSelectionList/MFnMesh after skinCluster creation and initialization before planner execution. This strongly identifies stale pre-skin MFnMesh lifetime across skinCluster/history insertion as the root cause candidate.

metadata.purpose: Validate the real skirt-parent planner plus all four parent-to-skirt transfers using a fresh post-skin MFnMesh. This restores the real selector path and transfer mutation after the stale-function-set A/B passed.
acceptance: Fast-forward AIMayaTool main and include commit 139ac07b6ee798bc9e75add41f96b95209ff2b44 or later.
Use a newly launched healthy managed Maya 2024 session with startup_timeout=90 and operation_timeout=45; force a fresh unsaved scene and do not save or quit Maya.

The smoke may use a pre-skin MFnMesh only to derive the root loop. After skinCluster creation and bulk initialization it must resolve a brand-new MSelectionList/MFnMesh and pass that fresh post-skin function set to build_skirt_parent_plan.
Use the real loop_selector/polySelect adapter and real apply_parent_transfers for all four assignments.

Require four transfer results with at least one changed component, verify a changed sample has parent weight near zero and skirt-joint total near one, and require AIBRIDGE_UI_SMOKE_OK:SKINNING_SKIRT_PARENT_TRANSFER_WORKFLOW_SMOKE_OK.

If PASS, treat stale pre-skin MFnMesh lifetime as confirmed for this crash chain and advance to the production smoothing-plan/full-workflow smoke with post-skin function-set discipline. If FAIL on a fresh session, preserve exact evidence and isolate whether the remaining trigger is real polySelect traversal or transfer mutation.
